product.name: Aurelio AC‑CP5
product.description: Designed for laptop users who demand efficient cooling without bulk, the Aurelio AC‑CP5 laptop cooling pad offers a lightweight aluminum frame with a silicone‑covered fan base that ensures a steady airflow across the keyboard and screen. Its 15 cm × 10 cm surface accommodates most 13‑ to 15‑inch laptops, while the adjustable height lever allows users to set a comfortable typing angle. The pad plugs into a single USB‑A port, drawing only 5 W of power, and features an LED indicator to confirm operation. A detachable cable and built‑in wrist rest provide added convenience for long sessions. The matte black finish and minimalistic design make it suitable for office, home, or travel use.
